about_the_game:
For quiet storytellers and reflective explorers, this Supporter Pack is a small offering for those who found a moment of peace within The Falling Star. Your support directly sustains us as independent developers, helping future stories of quiet emotion come to life.

As a token of gratitude, this pack includes two exclusive digital keepsakes that expand the world of the game:

  • Digital Picture Book: The Little Rabbit’s Garden

    The full story behind the hidden easter egg in The Falling Star. A 26-page, full-color illustrated book, lovingly designed in a printable 4"x6" postcard format and delivered in high resolution for both screen and print. Available in English, Simplified Chinese, French and Spanish.

  • Behind-the-Scenes Journal

    A 12-page PDF of early screenshots, developer notes, and personal reflections—an intimate glimpse into the creative process and the inspirations that shaped the game. Available in English only.

Thank you for being part of this journey. Your support is the quiet light that makes it possible to keep telling these stories.
